name: puppeteer_navigate
description: Navigates the browser to a URL.

name: puppeteer_screenshot
description: Takes a screenshot of the current page or a specific element.

name: puppeteer_click
description: Clicks an element on the page identified by a CSS selector.

name: puppeteer_fill
description: Fills a form input identified by a CSS selector with a value.

name: puppeteer_select
description: Selects an option from a dropdown by CSS selector and value.

name: puppeteer_hover
description: Hovers the cursor over an element identified by a CSS selector.

name: puppeteer_evaluate
description: Evaluates arbitrary JavaScript in the browser's page context.
